description:
AssignedToMe gathers every task assigned to you across the tools your team already uses — Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab and more — into one board, so nothing slips through the cracks.

• One board for everything assigned to you, across every connected source
• Each task links back to its source — open the original in one tap
• Update status, log time, comment and reassign without leaving the app
• Connected sources appear as tabs you can rename
• Refreshes automatically so your list stays current
• Your API keys are stored only in the device's secure Keychain — no account, no server, no tracking

Connect your tools once and see your real workload in seconds.
promotionalText: Every task assigned to you across Jira, Linear and GitHub — in one board, refreshed automatically.
